title: L2G-SR: Learning to Guide LLM-based Symbolic Regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.20685v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Symbolic regression searches for an equation that explains observed data. Numerical error is commonly used to guide the search, but it alone can favor an accurate surrogate over a candidate with the right structure. We propose L2G-SR, a framework for LLM-based symbolic regression that guides search with a learned structural verifier. We construct structural supervision signal using tree edit distance (TED), accounting for commutative operators and alternative expression forms. A verifier first aligns numerical observations with the formulas, then learns to score a candidate's structural similarity to the target formula. At search time, the target formula is hidden and the verifier complements numerical error in parent selection. An analyst then uses verifier feedback and diagnostic tools to propose revisions, which a generator converts into refined expressions. On LLM-SRBench, L2G-SR achieves state-of-the-art numerical fit, equation leve

translated_title: L2G-SR：学习引导基于大语言模型的符号回归
translated_abstract: 符号回归旨在搜索一个能解释观测数据的方程。数值误差通常被用来引导搜索，但仅依赖数值误差可能会偏好一个精确的替代函数，而忽略结构正确的候选公式。我们提出了L2G-SR，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的符号回归框架，通过学习得到的结构验证器来引导搜索。我们利用树编辑距离（TED）构建结构监督信号，并考虑了可交换运算符和替代表达式形式。验证器首先将数值观测与公式对齐，然后学习对候选公式与目标公式之间的结构相似度进行评分。在搜索阶段，目标公式被隐藏，验证器在父代选择中与数值误差形成互补。随后，分析者利用验证器反馈和诊断工具提出修改建议，生成器则将这些修改转化为精炼后的表达式。在LLM-SRBench上，L2G-SR实现了最先进的数值拟合度和方程级（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出L2G-SR框架，通过基于树编辑距离训练的结构验证器与数值误差互补来引导基于大语言模型的符号回归搜索，在LLM-SRBench上达到最先进的性能。
en_tdlr: L2G-SR introduces a learned structural verifier based on tree edit distance to complement numerical error in guiding LLM-based symbolic regression, achieving state-of-the-art performance on LLM-SRBench.
